The '''Saresh family''' was a rich and powerful [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] family native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], well-known for their cruelty and arrogance. Despite this, many of the family's members became members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], including [[Guun Han Saresh]], who became well-known for his exploits during the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] was also counted among the family members.
